Load data and packages 
```{r}
# Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# Load gene names
geneNames <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")

# Load covariate data
covar <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")

# Load gene expression data
geneExpression <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv") |>
  column_to_rownames("X")

# Check dimensions
dim(covar)
dim(geneExpression)
```

Step 2:Match gene expression data with covariate data
```{r}
biomarker <- t(geneExpression)

biomarker <- biomarker[covar$geoID, ]

dim(biomarker)

all(rownames(biomarker) == covar$geoID)
```
Step 3: Select the three genes
```{r}
selecgenes <- c("SSTR3", "CNR1", "NFYC")

geneNames %>%
  filter(GENE %in% selecgenes)
```
Step 4: Add selected genes to covariate data
```{r}
for (i in 1:length(selecgenes)) {
  
  probe <- geneNames$PROBEID[geneNames$GENE == selecgenes[i]]
  
  covar[[selecgenes[i]]] <- biomarker[, as.character(probe)]
  
}

dim(covar)
```
Step 5: Prepare the covariates
```{r}
covar <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")

covar$mat_age_yrs <- as.numeric(sub(".*: ", "", covar$mat_age_yrs))
covar$mat_BMI <- as.numeric(sub(".*: ", "", covar$mat_BMI))
covar$mat_vitD <- as.numeric(sub(".*: ", "", covar$mat_vitD))

covar$preg_preeclampsia <- sub(".*: ", "", covar$preg_preeclampsia)

covar$BMI_group <- ifelse(covar$mat_BMI < 25, "<25", ">=25")

table(covar$BMI_group)
```
Step 6: Prepare final dataset
```{r}
for (i in 1:length(selecgenes)) {
  probe <- geneNames$PROBEID[geneNames$GENE == selecgenes[i]]
  covar[[selecgenes[i]]] <- biomarker[, as.character(probe)]
}

cleandata <- covar[, c(
  "mat_age_yrs", "mat_BMI", "mat_vitD",
  "preg_preeclampsia", "BMI_group",
  selecgenes
)]

dim(cleandata)

```
Step 7: Create the summary statistics table
```{r}
summary_table <- cleandata %>%
  group_by(preg_preeclampsia) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Age_Mean = mean(mat_age_yrs, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_SD = sd(mat_age_yrs, na.rm = TRUE),
    BMI_Mean = mean(mat_BMI, na.rm = TRUE),
    BMI_SD = sd(mat_BMI, na.rm = TRUE),
    VitaminD_Mean = mean(mat_vitD, na.rm = TRUE),
    VitaminD_SD = sd(mat_vitD, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

summary_table
```
Step 8: BMI group summary
```{r}
bmi_table <- cleandata %>%
  group_by(preg_preeclampsia, BMI_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(preg_preeclampsia) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

bmi_table
```
